status.label: Confirm current Ctrl+Tab to Alt+Tab failures
status.detail: The report says swapping Ctrl+Tab and Alt+Tab fails intermittently and requires a reboot; a commenter points to the broader shortcut-failure tracker #35638.

judgment.rationale: The original Chinese report says Ctrl+Tab and Alt+Tab were swapped but the remap intermittently stops working and only a computer restart restores it. Diagnostic reports were attached in 2022 and by another user in 2023. A 2024 commenter points to #35638, which was closed as a duplicate of #17344; #17344 was closed in favor of open tracker #23231. Those reports cover intermittent Keyboard Manager shortcut failures broadly but do not confirm this exact mapping or recovery behavior.
evidence: The original report lists PowerToys 0.57.2 and the Ctrl+Tab/Alt+Tab swap.
The report says the shortcut fails intermittently and a reboot is the only known recovery.
Diagnostic reports were attached in 2022 and 2023; do not request another report before reviewing them.
A 2024 commenter links #35638; it was closed to #17344, which was closed to open tracker #23231.
No current-version confirmation or linked fix specific to this mapping was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the failure still occurs on current stable and whether restarting Keyboard Manager, locking/unlocking, or restarting PowerToys restores the mapping; review the existing reports first.

fix_assessment.rationale: If current builds still lose the mapping, Keyboard Manager may drop shortcut dispatch state after a lifecycle or input transition. Related tracker #23231 covers inconsistent shortcut remapping, but this exact Ctrl+Tab/Alt+Tab failure is not confirmed as the same mechanism.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep the Ctrl+Tab to Alt+Tab mapping active
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The shortcut remapping engine may stop dispatching the Ctrl+Tab/Alt+Tab swap after an unknown state transition; the old report does not identify whether a module toggle, lock, or reboot restores it.
plan: Confirm current-version behavior and the smallest recovery action using the existing diagnostic reports.
Reproduce the exact Ctrl+Tab/Alt+Tab swap through normal use and after lock/unlock.
Compare the failure with open tracker #23231 without assuming it is the same defect.
If a Keyboard Manager state loss is confirmed, correct the transition and add a regression test for the shortcut swap.
verification: Verify Ctrl+Tab and Alt+Tab continue to perform the configured swapped actions.
Verify the mapping recovers without rebooting after the triggering transition.
Verify other shortcut mappings and standalone Ctrl/Alt keys remain functional.

confidence.rationale: The report has a specific shortcut swap and recovery claim, but it is from 0.57.2 and no current reproduction or state transition has been confirmed.

issue_context.summary: Ctrl+Tab and Alt+Tab reportedly stop working after being swapped in Keyboard Manager, with reboot as the only known recovery.
known_information: The original report lists PowerToys 0.57.2 and swaps Ctrl+Tab with Alt+Tab.
The original report says the issue recurs and a full computer restart restores the remap.
Diagnostic reports were attached in 2022 and 2023.
The 2024 comment points to #35638, which routes through #17344 to open tracker #23231.
inferences: The symptom may belong to a broader intermittent shortcut-dispatch failure, but the exact mapping and recovery path are not established in the current tracker.
issue_context.analysis: The existing diagnostic attachments should be inspected before asking for new logs. Current-version and recovery observations are needed to distinguish a stale engine state from the broad tracking issue.
initial_investigation: Read the Chinese report, translation, and all three comments, including the two report attachments and tracker reference.
Reviewed #35638, #17344, and #23231; the first two are closed and #23231 remains open without a linked fix for this exact mapping.

information_gaps.information: Whether the Ctrl+Tab/Alt+Tab swap still fails on current stable and whether a module toggle, lock/unlock, or PowerToys restart restores it
information_gaps.why_needed: This identifies the current failure and minimum recovery boundary without repeating the already supplied diagnostic uploads.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the current version, whether the mapping fails after ordinary use or locking, and which of toggling Keyboard Manager, locking/unlocking, or restarting PowerToys restores it.

actions.label: Confirm current shortcut failure and recovery

comment.body: The report says the Ctrl+Tab/Alt+Tab swap fails intermittently and that reboot restores it. Could you confirm whether this still happens on current stable and whether toggling Keyboard Manager, locking/unlocking, or restarting PowerToys restores the mapping?
